summary: Full end-to-end testing of St Mary Arts landing page — 7/7 backend pytest cases pass; all critical frontend flows (hero, sticky header, nav, model cards, sticky checkout bar, inquiry dialog + submission, spec table highlight, contact block, WhatsApp href) verified via Playwright. End-to-end inquiry submission confirmed persisted in MongoDB with no _id leaked.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('shutdown') — consider migrating to lifespan context manager (non-blocking).
POST /api/inquiries responds with 200 instead of the more REST-conventional 201 Created (acceptable, but a minor nit).

InquiryDialog.jsx posts model as modelName (display name, e.g. 'Studio Acrylic · LED') rather than the model id — backend stores whatever string is sent, which is fine for the current schema but worth noting if later analytics want a stable id.
seed_data_creation: Created ~5 TEST_-prefixed inquiry documents in Mongo 'inquiries' collection during testing; no cleanup performed as backend exposes no delete endpoint.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers health + inquiry CRUD validation + desc sort. All passed. Frontend is single-page at '/'.
